name: Get Associated Emails
description: Retrieves emails associated with a specific object (contact, company, or deal). [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/search)

configurable_props.name: objectType
configurable_props.label: Associated Object Type
configurable_props.description: The type of the object the emails are associated with

configurable_props.name: objectId
configurable_props.label: Object ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the object to get associated emails for

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional Properties
configurable_props.description: Additional properties to retrieve for the emails

configurable_props.name: limit
configurable_props.label: Limit
configurable_props.description: Maximum number of emails to retrieve
